value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly identifies a phase transition at kappa=1 but does not quantify it. The new claim gives its critical exponent and coefficient, shows the optimizing shape escapes at the reciprocal square-root rate, supplies a universal one-dimensional Mills coordinate for the entire supercritical branch, and identifies the large-threshold endpoint constant. These are structural descriptions of the sharp minimization problem rather than a routine numerical refinement.
